subproblem.title: Blow-ups at a good point converge to a constant-orientation cycle with the integer slice property
subproblem.statement: Hypothesis names: (REP), (MR), (SL) are the exact frozen statements of the DAG theorems cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_slice_mass_bounds (hypotheses of the selected parent cbr_cycle_isIntegerMultiplicity); (RU) is the exact frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq, (CT) = (T1) ∧ (T2) ∧ (MM) that of cbr_measure_convergence_tools, (RECT) that of cbr_rectifiable_of_approx_tangent; whichever are needed appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement. In words: (REP) a current T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U has a mass representation (μ, ξ): μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, μ(W) = M_W(T) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 provided also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U; (MR) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for an IMRep R of T in an open U and open W; (SL) for T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) with admissible representations (μ, ξ) of T and (μ', ξ') of ∂T and L-Lipschitz f there are currents A_t, B_t with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h < f < t}) and ∫_a^b M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ Lμ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W; (RU) an identity ∫ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫ξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫ξ₃(ω)dμ₃ between admissible pairs, valid for all test forms on an open U, remains valid with all integrals restricted to any Borel set; (T1) measures μ_j with sup_jμ_j(K) < ∞ on compacts have a subsequence converging to a Radon μ (against C_c, limsup on compacts ≤ μ, liminf on open sets ≥ μ); (T2) if X_j ⇀ X with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j), (μ_X, ξ_X), limsup_jμ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) on compacts, f continuous and μ{f = t} = 0, then ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j → ∫_{f<t}ξ_X(ω)dμ_X; (MM) if Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t−h < f < t}) on (a, b) then some measurable g ≥ liminf_jZ_j a.e. on (a, b) has ∫_a^b g ≤ L·liminf_jμ_j(G ∩ {a < f < b}); (RECT) a Borel M with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ having approximate tangent spaces Q(x) at Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M with x ↦ p_{Q(x)} Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable is countably n-rectifiable. Notation: Hⁿ = μHE[n], ω_n = unitBallVolume n, |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α for covectors, admissible representation (μ, ξ) of a current X in ℝ^P: μ Borel, finite on compact sets, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e., X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for every test form. ISP (integer slice property) of Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P): for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t, all A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms have ∂A − B integer multiplicity. For a ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0 let η(y) := dilation a λ y = λ⁻¹(y − a); X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) is called a dilation of X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) if X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all test m-forms ω, ω' on ℝ^P with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Assume (SL), (RU), (CT). Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, and assume SLIM_{P,d}: if X_i, X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), every X_i has ISP, sup_i(M_W(X_i) + M_W(∂X_i)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure, and X_i ⇀ X, then X has ISP (the conclusion of cbr_slice_property_of_weak_limit for fixed d, P). Let Γ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂Γ = 0 and ISP; μ a finite Borel measure with μ(W) = M_W(Γ) for open W; M Borel with Hⁿ(M) < ∞; θ Borel, ζ strongly measurable, μ = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ, θ > 0 on M, |ζ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, and for each x ∈ M some β with |β| ≤ 1 and ζ(x)(β) = 1; Γ(ω) = ∫_Mθζ(ω)dHⁿ for all ω. Let a ∈ M and η₁ > 0 with liminf_{r↓0}μ(B_r(a))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₁, limsup_{r↓0}Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_r(a))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≤ 1 and (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_r(a)}‖θζ − θ(a)ζ(a)‖dHⁿ)/(ω_nrⁿ) → 0 as r ↓ 0. Let λ_i > 0, λ_i → 0. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ, a Borel measure ν finite on compact sets, currents C, Γ_k ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and pairs (μ_k, ξ_k) such that, with θ₀ := θ(a) and N_k := blowUpMap a λ_{φ(k)} '' M = η_{a,λ_{φ(k)}}(M): ν(B_R(0)) ≤ ω_nRⁿ and ν(B_R(0)) > 0 for all R > 0; C(ω) = ∫θ₀ζ(a)(ω(y))dν(y), ∂C = 0, M_W(C) = θ₀ν(W) for open W, and C has ISP; Γ_k ⇀ C, ∂Γ_k = 0, μ_k finite on compacts with μ_k(W) = M_W(Γ_k) for open W, (μ_k, ξ_k) an admissible representation of Γ_k; limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K) for compact K; μ_k(ℝ^P∖N_k) = 0; limsup_kHⁿ(N_k ∩ K) ≤ ν(K) for compact K; and ∫_{N_k}f dHⁿ → ∫f dν for every continuous compactly supported f.

Source: parent proof, step 4 (second half) and step 5 (V8, blow-ups), using the siblings dilation_calculus (dc), dilation_isp (di) and const_mass (cm).
0. Notation and norm facts. τ := θζ, θ₀ := θ(a) > 0 (a ∈ M), τ₀ := τ(a) = θ₀ζ(a). |·| is covectorEuclideanNorm, |ζ|* := sup{ζ(β) : |β| ≤ 1} (a norm on Λ_n, attained), ‖·‖ operator norms. (F1) ‖α‖_op ≤ Pⁿ|α| for n-covectors α: for unit vectors u_1, …, u_n expand u_k = Σ_iu_k^ie_i, so α(u) = Σ_{J:Fin n→Fin P}(Π_ku_k^{J(k)})α(e_{J(1)}, …, e_{J(n)}) with |u_k^i| ≤ 1 and |α(e_J)| ≤ |α| (0 if J is not injective, ± a coefficient α(e_I) of the increasing rearrangement I otherwise); hence |α(u)| ≤ Pⁿ|α|. Consequently |ζ|* ≤ Pⁿ‖ζ‖ and |ζ(ω)| ≤ ‖ζ‖‖ω‖_op ≤ Pⁿ‖ζ‖|ω| for n-vectors ζ. (F2) For x ∈ M, |ζ(x)|* = 1 (the bound and the given β), so |τ(x)|* = θ(x), |τ₀|* = θ₀ and |θ(x) − θ₀| ≤ |τ(x) − τ₀|* ≤ Pⁿ‖τ(x) − τ₀‖. η_i := dilation a λ_i, η_i(y) = λ_i⁻¹(y − a) = blowUpMap a λ_i y, η_i⁻¹(y) = a + λ_iy; ω_n := unitBallVolume n; ‖ω‖_∞ := sup_y‖ω(y)‖_op. Γ(ω) = ∫ζ(ω)dμ for all ω, because μ = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity(ofReal∘θ) (integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul).
1. Density bounds at a. o(r) := ∫_{M∩B̄_r(a)}‖τ − τ₀‖dHⁿ satisfies o(r)/(ω_nrⁿ) → 0. For r > 0, μ(B_r(a)) = ∫_{M∩B_r(a)}θ dHⁿ ≤ θ₀Hⁿ(M ∩ B_r(a)) + ∫_{M∩B_r(a)}|θ − θ₀|dHⁿ ≤ θ₀Hⁿ(M ∩ B_r(a)) + Pⁿo(r) (F2). By the lower density hypothesis μ(B_r(a)) ≥ (η₁/2)ω_nrⁿ for small r, and Pⁿo(r) ≤ (η₁/4)ω_nrⁿ for small r; so there is r₀ > 0 with Hⁿ(M ∩ B_r(a)) ≥ (η₁/(4θ₀))ω_nrⁿ and (upper density hypothesis) Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_r(a)) ≤ 2ω_nrⁿ for 0 < r < r₀.
2. Blow-ups. By (dc)(1) let Γ_i' be a dilation of Γ by η_i. By (dc)(2) and ∂Γ = 0, ∂Γ_i'(φ) = λ_i^{−d}∂Γ(φ∘η_i) = 0, so ∂Γ_i' = 0. Let μ_i' := ofReal(λ_i^{−n})·η_{i*}μ, ξ_i'(y) := ζ(a + λ_iy): by (dc)(4), Γ_i'(ω) = ∫ξ_i'(ω)dμ_i'; ξ_i' is strongly measurable with |ξ_i'(y)(α)| ≤ |α|; μ_i'(K) ≤ λ_i^{−n}μ(ℝ^P) < ∞. For open W', W := η_i⁻¹(W') is open with η_i(W) = W', so by (dc)(5) M_{W'}(Γ_i') = λ_i^{−n}M_W(Γ) = λ_i^{−n}μ(η_i⁻¹(W')) = μ_i'(W'). μ(ℝ^P∖M) = 0 and η_i⁻¹(ℝ^P∖η_i(M)) = ℝ^P∖M, so μ_i'(ℝ^P∖η_i(M)) = 0 (η_i(M) is Borel). Let ν_i := Hⁿ⌞η_i(M). By (dc)(6), Hⁿ(η_i(A)) = λ_i^{−n}Hⁿ(A); hence ν_i(K) = λ_i^{−n}Hⁿ(M ∩ η_i⁻¹(K)) and, by change of variables, Γ_i'(ω) = λ_i^{−n}∫_Mθ(x)ζ(x)(ω(η_i(x)))dHⁿ(x) = ∫_{η_i(M)}τ(a + λ_iy)(ω(y))dHⁿ(y).
3. Uniform bounds. For R > 0 and compact K ⊆ B̄_R(0): ν_i(K) ≤ λ_i^{−n}Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_{λ_iR}(a)) ≤ 2ω_nRⁿ when λ_iR < r₀, and ν_i(K) ≤ λ_i^{−n}Hⁿ(M) < ∞ for every i; hence sup_iν_i(K) < ∞ for every compact K. For λ_iR < r₀, ν_i(B_R(0)) = λ_i^{−n}Hⁿ(M ∩ B_{λ_iR}(a)) ≥ (η₁/(4θ₀))ω_nRⁿ.
4. Approximation by a constant n-vector. For a Borel set G ⊆ B_R(0): ∫_{η_i(M)∩G}‖τ(a + λ_iy) − τ₀‖dHⁿ(y) = λ_i^{−n}∫_{M∩η_i⁻¹(G)}‖τ − τ₀‖dHⁿ ≤ λ_i^{−n}o(λ_iR) = ω_nRⁿ·o(λ_iR)/(ω_n(λ_iR)ⁿ) =: ε_i(R) → 0 (*). Hence for ω with tsupport ω ⊆ B_R(0): |Γ_i'(ω) − ∫τ₀(ω)dν_i| ≤ ‖ω‖_∞ε_i(R) → 0.
5. Compactness. Apply (CT)(T1) with U := ℝ^P to (ν_i): a strictly increasing φ and a Borel measure ν, finite on compacts, with ∫f dν_{φ(k)} → ∫f dν for continuous compactly supported f, limsup_kν_{φ(k)}(K) ≤ ν(K) for compact K and ν(G) ≤ liminf_kν_{φ(k)}(G) for open G. Put Γ_k := Γ'_{φ(k)}, μ_k := μ'_{φ(k)}, ξ_k := ξ'_{φ(k)}, N_k := η_{φ(k)}(M) = blowUpMap a λ_{φ(k)} '' M. By step 2, ∂Γ_k = 0, (μ_k, ξ_k) is an admissible representation with μ_k(W) = M_W(Γ_k) for open W, μ_k is finite on compacts and μ_k(ℝ^P∖N_k) = 0; Hⁿ(N_k ∩ K) = ν_{φ(k)}(K), so limsup_kHⁿ(N_k ∩ K) ≤ ν(K), and ∫_{N_k}f dHⁿ = ∫f dν_{φ(k)} → ∫f dν.
6. The limit current. C(ω) := ∫τ₀(ω(y))dν(y) = ∫θ₀ζ(a)(ω(y))dν(y): the integrand is continuous with compact support, so C is a well-defined linear functional, and |C(ω)| ≤ ‖τ₀‖‖ω‖_∞ν(K) when tsupport ω ⊆ K, whence sequential continuity in 𝒟^n(ℝ^P): C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P). For every ω (tsupport ω ⊆ B_R(0) for some R), Γ_k(ω) − C(ω) = [Γ_k(ω) − ∫τ₀(ω)dν_{φ(k)}] + [∫τ₀(ω)dν_{φ(k)} − ∫τ₀(ω)dν] → 0 by steps 4 and 5. So Γ_k ⇀ C.
7. Bounds for ν. For R > 0: ν(B_R(0)) ≤ liminf_kν_{φ(k)}(B_R(0)) ≤ liminf_kλ_{φ(k)}^{−n}Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_{λ_{φ(k)}R}(a)) ≤ ω_nRⁿ·limsup_{r↓0}Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_r(a))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≤ ω_nRⁿ. And ν(B_R(0)) ≥ ν(B̄_{R/2}(0)) ≥ limsup_kν_{φ(k)}(B̄_{R/2}(0)) ≥ (η₁/(4θ₀))ω_n(R/2)ⁿ > 0 (step 3).
8. ∂C = 0: for a test d-form φ, ∂C(φ) = C(dφ) = lim_kΓ_k(dφ) = lim_k∂Γ_k(φ) = 0.
9. Mass of C. (cm) with m := n, ν, ζ₀ := θ₀•ζ(a), s := θ₀: |θ₀ζ(a)(α)| ≤ θ₀|α| and θ₀ζ(a)(β) = θ₀ for the β of ζ(a) (|β| ≤ 1); so M_W(C) = θ₀ν(W) for open W.
10. limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K). Ξ_k(ω) := ∫τ₀(ω)dν_{φ(k)} is a current (as in step 6), and M_G(Ξ_k) = θ₀ν_{φ(k)}(G) for open G by (cm). For a bounded open G ⊆ B_R(0) and ω admissible for M_G: Γ_k(ω) = Ξ_k(ω) + (Γ_k − Ξ_k)(ω) ≤ θ₀ν_{φ(k)}(G) + ∫_{N_k∩G}‖τ(a + λ_{φ(k)}y) − τ₀‖‖ω(y)‖_op dHⁿ ≤ θ₀ν_{φ(k)}(G) + Pⁿε_{φ(k)}(R) (‖ω(y)‖_op ≤ Pⁿ|ω(y)| ≤ Pⁿ by (F1), and (*)). So μ_k(G) = M_G(Γ_k) ≤ θ₀ν_{φ(k)}(G) + Pⁿε_{φ(k)}(R). For compact K and δ > 0 let G := Metric.thickening δ K (open, bounded, ⊆ the compact set K_δ := Metric.cthickening δ K; G = ∅ if K = ∅): limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ limsup_kμ_k(G) ≤ θ₀limsup_kν_{φ(k)}(K_δ) ≤ θ₀ν(K_δ), and ν(K_δ) ↓ ν(K) as δ ↓ 0 (⋂_δK_δ = K, ν(K_1) < ∞). Hence limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K).
11. ISP of C. Each Γ_k has ISP by (di) applied to X := Γ, X' := Γ_k, λ := λ_{φ(k)}, (μ_X, ξ_X) := (μ, ζ) (∂Γ = 0, μ finite on compacts, ζ strongly measurable with |ζ(α)| ≤ |α|, Γ(ω) = ∫ζ(ω)dμ, ISP of Γ, Γ_k a dilation of Γ). For open W with compact closure K: M_W(Γ_k) + M_W(∂Γ_k) = μ_k(W) + 0 ≤ μ_k(K) (the zero current has zero mass), and sup_kμ_k(K) < ∞ since each μ_k(K) < ∞ and limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K) < ∞ (step 10). With Γ_k ⇀ C (step 6), SLIM_{P,d} gives that C has ISP.
12. Steps 5–11 give all asserted properties of φ, ν, C, Γ_k, μ_k, ξ_k, N_k. ∎
proof_key_steps: Density bounds at a: (η₁/(4θ₀))ω_nrⁿ ≤ Hⁿ(M ∩ B_r(a)) ≤ 2ω_nrⁿ for small r, from the three good-point hypotheses and |θ − θ₀| ≤ Pⁿ‖τ − τ₀‖ on M.
Blow-ups Γ_i' = dilations of Γ: cycles with mass representations λ^{−n}η_*μ and Γ_i'(ω) = ∫_{η_i(M)}τ(a + λ_iy)(ω)dHⁿ (dc).
(T1) gives Hⁿ⌞η_i(M) → ν along a subsequence; the Lebesgue point estimate gives Γ_k ⇀ C = ∫θ₀ζ(a)(ω)dν.
Bounds on ν, ∂C = 0, M_W(C) = θ₀ν(W) (cm), and limsup μ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K) via the constant-vector comparison.
Each Γ_k has ISP (di); SLIM_{P,d} gives ISP of C.
